# Support

- **How-to guides and field notes:** the [GoC guide library](https://lipford-dutch.github.io/goc-guide-library/).
- **Questions:** [Q&A discussions](https://github.com/Lipford-Dutch/.github/discussions/categories/q-a).
- **Ideas and show-and-tell:** [org discussions](https://github.com/Lipford-Dutch/.github/discussions).
- **Bugs and features:** open an issue on the repository that owns the work, if issues are enabled there.
- **Security:** see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

We do not offer a public service desk. Response times vary with maintainer availability.
